description: Find USDA AMS My Market News reports outside livestock: fruit and vegetable shipping-point and terminal-market prices (limes, tomatoes, avocados...), Mexico and other import crossings, grain bids, hay, cotton, ornamentals and more (about a thousand reports). Words in `query` must all appear in the report title, slug, market type or office, e.g. "shipping point fruit", "mcallen", "terminal market vegetables", "grain bids". Returns report_id, title, market types, office, sections and last published date. Commodities (limes, apples, corn...) and crossing districts are fields INSIDE a report's rows, not in its title: a produce report is named for the AMS office, e.g. "Phoenix Shipping Point Fruit Prices" carries limes from Mexico crossings through Texas. Find the office/market-type report here, then filter its rows with `commodity` and `district` in ams_market_report. Use the report_id with ams_market_report. If nothing matches the result says so and gives the market types that exist; it is never a bare empty list. Livestock price reports are ams_report_search.

_apiKey.description: Optional. The gateway supplies the platform My Market News key; pass your own only to override.

market_type.description: Restrict to reports whose market type contains this text, e.g. "Shipping Point" or "Terminal".

query.description: Words that must all appear in the report title, slug, market type or office, e.g. "mcallen fruit" or "texas grain bids".

name: ams_market_report_search
